title: $BMS_3$-like algebras via the $Z_N$-graded $u(1)^2$ Kac-Moody algebra
summary: The Sugawara construction provides a natural way to construct the Virasoro algebra from a current algebra. It was shown in Ref.~\cite{Ghazi:2025oin} that for the $u(1)^2$ Kac-Moody current algebra, there exist additional constructions that exhibit a $\mathbb{Z}_N$-graded structure. Indeed, the space of such constructions defines a non-compact algebraic variety whose dimension depends on $N$.
